name: farmmeasure
description: A web-based tool for measuring agricultural field boundaries and calculating land area. Built with vanilla JavaScript and Leaflet. Runs entirely in your browser — no server, no account; map tiles are fetched from OpenStreetMap/MapTiler.

scripts.test:unit: npm run lint && node scripts/test-math.js && node scripts/test-i18n.js
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && node scripts/test-math.js && node scripts/test-i18n.js
scripts.test: node scripts/smoke.js && node scripts/smoke-pdf.js && node scripts/smoke-storage.js && node scripts/test-math.js && node scripts/test-i18n.js
